mechanism_narrative: A 2% quarterly increase in GDP signals strengthening economic growth, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of quarters with 2%+ GDP growth, or quarterly GDP growth > 2% fails to correlate with increased consumer spending (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, S&P 500 forward returns are likely to be negative over the next 20 trading days due to increased borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 1.5%, or tightening cycles fail to show significant correlation with decreased equity valuations (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between rising UNRATE (> 0.5pp in 2 months) and slowing PAYEMS growth (< 0.5% MoM) signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 2mo & PAYEMS growth < 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or the described labor market conditions fail to precede > 60% of subsequent 60d SPX downturns.

mechanism_narrative: A 5% monthly increase in INDPRO signals increased industrial production, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 55% of months with 5%+ INDPRO growth, or INDPRO growth > 5% does not significantly correlate with subsequent equity market growth (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds 600K units, signaling strong housing demand, S&P 500 forward returns are likely to be positive over the next 5 trading days due to the housing market's impact on the broader economy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of periods with HOUST > 600K, or housing demand fails to show significant correlation with short-term equity market growth (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between low FEDFUNDS (< 0.5%) and high RSAFS (> $350B) signals accommodative monetary policy and strong retail sales, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window, or the described monetary and retail conditions fail to precede > 50% of subsequent 20d SPX uptrends.

mechanism_narrative: A 1% monthly decrease in UNRATE signals tightening labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to anticipated wage growth and increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 60d returns in > 50% of months with 1%+ UNRATE decreases, or UNRATE decreases > 1% do not significantly correlate with subsequent equity market growth (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 220, signaling high inflation, S&P 500 forward returns are likely to be negative over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated monetary policy responses.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 220, or high inflation fails to show significant correlation with short-term equity market declines (p > 0.05).
